# FlareStepper

`Flare.Components.FlareStepper`

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ActionContent` | `RenderFragment<StepperContext>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Optional navigation content rendered in place of the built-in Back/Next buttons. Receives a StepperContext with the active position and the navigation operations, so a consumer can render bespoke controls (custom icon buttons, wheel/keyboard navigation, ...). When null (the default) the component renders its built-in Back/Next buttons. |
| `ActiveIndex` | `int` | `0` | Parameter |  | Zero-based index of the active step. Supports two-way binding (@bind-ActiveIndex): the component writes the new index out via ActiveIndexChanged on every navigation, and adopts an externally assigned value (e.g. from a consumer's custom controls) on the next render. An out-of-range value is clamped to the registered step count. The getter always reports the live active step, so reading it after a navigation reflects the current position. |
| `ActiveIndexChanged` | `EventCallback<int>` | `` | Callback |  | Fired with the new index whenever ActiveIndex changes (Next/Back/click or a programmatic move), enabling @bind-ActiveIndex. For a plain "step changed" notification without binding, use OnStepChanged instead (both fire). |
| `AriaLabel` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Accessible label for the step indicator tab list. Defaults to localised "Progress steps". |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | FlareStep descriptors registered as children. |
| `Linear` | `bool` | `true` | Parameter |  | Prevents skipping ahead to non-completed steps. |
| `NonLinear` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Allows clicking any step regardless of completion when true. |
| `OnStepChanged` | `EventCallback<int>` | `` | Callback |  | Callback fired when the active step index changes. |
| `OnStepChanging` | `Func<StepperChange, Task<bool>>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Async guard fired BEFORE the active step changes (any navigation: Next/Back/click). Return false to block the change -- e.g. validate the current step before advancing. The StepperChange carries the current and target indices, so a handler that only validates forward moves can allow change.To < change.From. |
| `Orientation` | `StepperOrientation` | `StepperOrientation.Horizontal` | Parameter |  | Layout orientation - horizontal or vertical. |

| `Style` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Inline style string appended to the component's root element. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |

## Methods

### `Back()`

Returns to the previous step. No-op on the first step. Runs the OnStepChanging guard.
Returns: `Task`.

### `GoTo(int index)`

Navigates to index (clamped to range) when allowed by the linear/skippable rules. Runs the OnStepChanging guard.
Returns: `Task`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | `int` | Zero-based target step index. |

### `Next()`

Advances to the next step. No-op on the last step. Runs the OnStepChanging guard.
Returns: `Task`.
